name: How durable is privacy glass and what is its lifespan?

mainEntity.name: How durable is privacy glass and what is its lifespan?

acceptedAnswer.text: The durability and lifespan of privacy glass depend on the type chosen. Etched or sandblasted glass is highly durable, with the privacy effect lasting indefinitely as it's an integral part of the glass itself. Tinted or frosted films typically have a lifespan of 10-15 years, depending on exposure to sun and proper maintenance, and can be replaced if they start to degrade. Smart glass, with its electronic components, generally has a lifespan comparable to other high-quality window units, often exceeding 15-20 years with proper care. We ensure quality products and professional installation for maximum longevity.
